categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in human pharmaceuticals (77%), animal pharmaceuticals (8%), medical devices (5%), daily beauty and health products (7%), and others (3%). It produces prescription and over-the-counter drugs, medical instruments like blood pressure and glucose monitors, animal health products, and personal care items. The company also engages in health foods and home care services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing processes including tablet, capsule, injection, ointment, and suppository production lines. It has developed key special formulation platforms such as nano-grinding and microsphere coating technologies. The company emphasizes GMP compliance, quality assurance, and integrates digital management systems for production and supply chain efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include hospitals, clinics, chain pharmacies, and distributors domestically, as well as international pharmaceutical partners. Animal health products are sold to pig farms, poultry farms, dairy farms, feed mills, veterinary hospitals, and overseas agents. The company targets both human and veterinary pharmaceutical markets, health and beauty consumers, and the aging population requiring home care services.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover Taiwan as the primary domestic market, with active expansion into international markets including the US, Europe, Japan, and emerging markets in Asia-Pacific. The company has subsidiaries and manufacturing facilities in China (Suzhou, Shanghai), Hong Kong, and Cayman Islands for investment holding. It participates in global pharmaceutical supply chains and international exhibitions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly midstream and downstream in the pharmaceutical supply chain, including drug formulation, manufacturing, packaging, and distribution. It sources raw materials and packaging from qualified global suppliers and maintains strict quality control. It also engages in licensing, agency, and distribution agreements with international partners.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include international market expansion, product and service portfolio optimization, and digital transformation. R&D focuses on new drug registrations, special formulation technologies, biopharmaceuticals, and niche generic products. The company collaborates with academic and industry partners for new drug development and integrates AI and smart medical technologies to enhance product safety and service quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and health products. Additional income streams include licensing, agency and distribution fees, and health service offerings. The company also benefits from government health insurance reimbursements and export sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international pharmaceutical firms and domestic generic drug manufacturers. It positions itself as an integrated pharmaceutical company with vertical integration from raw materials to finished products, emphasizing quality, innovation, and regulatory compliance. It leverages strategic alliances and digital capabilities to maintain competitiveness in both domestic and global markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, consolidated revenue reached approximately NT$8.9 billion, a 4% increase year-over-year, with a gross margin of 38.2%. Operating profit increased by nearly 30%, while net profit slightly declined by 1.5%. The company maintains a stable asset base of around NT$12.7 billion and equity of NT$7.5 billion, showing steady growth and financial stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality pharmaceutical products compliant with international GMP standards, advanced formulation technologies, and comprehensive customer service. It differentiates through integrated R&D capabilities, digital management systems, and a strong commitment to sustainability and corporate social responsibility. Its focus on innovation, regulatory compliance, and customer-centric solutions supports its competitive edge.
